explication: direnv augments interactive shells by detecting directory changes and applying authorized, project-specific environment changes. The main documented flow runs .envrc (and optionally .env) in a Bash subprocess, captures exported variables, computes a difference, and emits shell-specific commands. The tree and excerpts show the CLI entry point, environment/diff utilities, dotenv parsing, file watches, and fetchurl/SRI implementation; several workflow stages and integrations are documented but their implementation details were not sampled.
